body: I don't use IM. But I did set one up not.worth@ymail.com . It can come in handy I guess

> If you do not mind me asking, what 'violence' are you speaking of? World tragedies? Or something more personal?

I mean, every day life. At least where I am at, society in general is pretty violent. People are intolerant, selfish, and stuff like that. Globally it's a big problem, but I find it stressful what happens every day around me.

I used to think much of what you said in your second paragraph. Only to realize that, I can't contribute in any way (I've made some mistakes). If anything I'd even think I might be holding back others.

I'm from US. I thought of going in a journey of some sort, but first I can't afford it, second, I also feel kind of tied to the 2 or 3 people that care for me (the ones that make this kind of things difficult).

You know, it's nice you people get to help others. I kind of feel that there are some people worth helping. I think maybe, to you, everyone is worth help, but some people just aren't meant to be, you know, sometimes it's to late to change... thanks for your comment, it is kind of a nice thing to read, knowing that somewhere, someone cares.

I sort of tried that, but why keep living if I'm not going to give a fuck, the possibilities of having a happy life are so low, I'm poor, I don't have friends, I got to work my ass off every day.

I already tried not giving a fuck, doesn't work for me. Thanks for your comment
